Machoke

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Machoke is a Fighting-type Superpower Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 70.5 kg. It evolves from Machop and into Machamp. Its highest base stat is Attack (100), with a base stat total of 405.
